title: PR8123 Staging gateway governance pool routing environment impact

phases.objective: Route gateway authority reads through the Governance DB while preserving Runtime DB workspace resolution and all provider, database, and Production mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head against the canonical environment-impact policy and gateway convergence contracts.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Governance-owned authority reads use the Governance DB, workspace reads remain on Runtime DB, live Staging certification remains required, and Production mutation remains denied.
steps: Classify the exact base-to-head paths against the canonical environment-impact policy.
Verify resource binding, capability envelope, and dispatch certification reads use the Governance DB pool.
Verify workspace resolution remains on the Runtime DB pool.
Verify the Staging Recovery Gateway preflight is server-hard-bound to the Staging adapter and cannot select Production from caller assertions.
Verify provider apply still requires live authority preflight and no Production mutation is authorized.
assertions: The environment impact source of truth is the canonical deployment branch policy.
Staging and production are declared because the changed runtime paths are shared.
Cross-environment review is explicit and live Staging certification remains required.
Runtime and Governance database pools cannot be explicitly composed as the same pool.
No database write, provider mutation, credential payload read, or Production activation is introduced.
Staging Recovery never selects the Production rollout implementation from expected_policy_hash or other caller assertions.
Governance authority reads never fall back to the Runtime DB pool.
The generic Staging rollout surface may server-resolve the Governance Authority Store, but it never aliases deps.pool as Governance or proxies Runtime SQL into Governance.
